title: SX AO simulator fails to clamp its axis limits
description:
`indigo_drivers/ao_sx/ao_sx_simulator/ao_sx_simulator.ino:49,58,67,76` uses comparison expressions (`dec == limit`, etc.) where movement-limit assignment is intended. A normal GN/GS/GT/GW request crossing the configured ±50 limit acknowledges L but leaves the stored coordinate outside the limit. Subsequent L status uses exact equality at88-96, so it reports no matching limit bit for that overrun. The west negative branch also names positive limit. Current driver sends the same six-byte directional step commands and consumes the one-byte acknowledgement/limit status. This undermines manual limit/return-to-center testing without proving a physi Full source contracts: helper-manual-review.md H-01. Remedy: assign the matching positive/negative boundary after each crossing and verify all four directions, exact limit, first step beyond it, L status and K/R center reset using an isolated firmware fixture/board. No firmware was compiled/flashed or transport opened in this audit.
